_comment: CELPIP Speaking Task 2: Talking about a Personal Experience.

items.prompt: Talk about a time when you had to learn something new very quickly. What happened, and how did you manage?
Talk about a time when you helped a stranger. What was the situation, and what did you do?
Talk about a time when you got lost or could not find a place you were looking for. What happened?
Talk about a celebration that you remember well. What were you celebrating, and why was it memorable?
Talk about a trip when something did not go as planned. What went wrong, and what did you do?
Talk about a time when you received some very good news. What was the news, and how did you react?
Talk about a time when you solved a difficult problem at work or at school. What was the problem, and how did you solve it?
Talk about how you met one of your close friends. Where were you, and how did your friendship start?
Talk about the first time you tried a food from another culture. What was it, and what did you think of it?
Talk about a time when you changed your mind about something important. What made you change it?
